stories.title: France vs. Slovenia — Wemby Leads France TONIGHT at Paris Accor Arena

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text:
Wemby. Paris. Home crowd. TONIGHT.

France (5-1) hosts Slovenia at Accor Arena at 6:30 PM UTC. Luka Doncic? Sitting at home with his kids.

Victor Wembanyama has the stage all to himself. 🇫🇷

#HoopHeroes #FIBA #Wembanyama

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text:
France is 5-1 after beating Serbia 91-90 on Tuesday. Slovenia is 3-3 and missing Luka Doncic.

Wembanyama is France's captain AND playing in his hometown tonight. The Accor Arena crowd is going to be electric.

#HoopHeroes #Wembanyama

facebook.long_form:
🇫🇷 TONIGHT: Victor Wembanyama takes center stage in Paris.

France hosts Slovenia at the Accor Arena tonight (6:30 PM UTC) in a FIBA Basketball World Cup 2027 European Qualifier, and the setting could not be more perfect for Wemby.

France enters 5-1 in Group L after the thrilling 91-90 win over Serbia on Tuesday, where Wembanyama scored 18 points in front of an electric Orleans crowd. Tonight? It's back home in Paris, in front of HIS people.

The biggest subplot: Luka Doncic opted not to play for Slovenia this summer. The two-time NBA All-Star is focusing on hamstring rehab and family time. That takes away Slovenia's biggest threat — and puts Wembanyama front and center as the night's undisputed star.

France's captain. France's best player. On French soil. Against a Slovenia team going 3-3 without their best player.

The window to the 2027 World Cup is wide open. Wemby knows it. Tonight he gets to prove it.

Who's watching? 👇

stories.title: Shaedon Sharpe Tears Meniscus — Out 6 Months, Blazers' Season on Hold

x_posts.label: Post 2-1
x_posts.text:
INJURY NEWS: Shaedon Sharpe (Portland) has torn the meniscus in his right knee and will miss SIX months.

He averaged a career-high 20.8 ppg last season. The Blazers just got Ja Morant.

Now Morant carries the load alone to start 2026-27. 😬

#TrailBlazers #HoopHeroes

x_posts.label: Post 2-2
x_posts.text:
Shaedon Sharpe tearing his meniscus is a gut punch for Portland.

Blazers traded for Ja Morant to be a contender. Now their No. 2 option is out until February.

Six months. The whole first half of the season. Gone.

#TrailBlazers #HoopHeroes

facebook.long_form:
💔 Portland's big plans just took a devastating hit.

Shaedon Sharpe has torn the meniscus in his right knee and will miss approximately SIX months — sidelining him until late February or early March, per ESPN.

Let that sink in. The Blazers' No. 2 star is out for the entire first half of the 2026-27 season.

Sharpe, 23, was coming off a breakout year. He averaged a career-high 20.8 points and 4.3 rebounds per game in 2025-26 and was ready to step into a major role alongside Ja Morant — the centerpiece of Portland's offseason rebuild.

The Blazers gave up a monster package to get Morant from Memphis. The whole plan was Morant + Sharpe building something special. Now Morant has to carry the load alone to start the season.

Surgery is scheduled for this week. The six-month recovery math puts Sharpe back around February 27 at the earliest.

Is this a death blow to Portland's contender aspirations? Or does it change the timeline instead of killing it?

One thing's certain: Ja Morant is going to earn every penny from Day 1.

Thoughts on the Blazers' season outlook? Drop them below 👇

stories.title: Stephen Curry Extension — 2 Days to August 29 Window

x_posts.label: Post 3
x_posts.text:
2 days.

Stephen Curry's extension window opens Saturday, August 29. The Warriors are expected to sign their guy to a new deal.

36 years old. The last of the Splash Brothers. Still a Warrior for life.

#Warriors #HoopHeroes #StephCurry

facebook.long_form:
⏰ 2 days. That's how long we wait to see Stephen Curry officially commit to the Golden State Warriors for the rest of his career.

The extension window opens Saturday, August 29. The expected deal: two years, $136.7 million max — carrying Curry through his age-38 season and beyond.

Warriors GM Mike Dunleavy Jr. has been clear: the Warriors plan to offer Curry whatever he wants, up to the max. ESPN's Anthony Slater confirmed the mutual desire is there. This is happening.

The only dissenting voice? ESPN's Brian Windhorst, who has suggested Curry should wait — allowing the Warriors more salary cap flexibility to build around him. It's a valid point. But Curry has made no secret of his desire to retire as a Warrior.

Think about what this man has meant to Golden State: 4 championships, 2 MVPs, the greatest shooter in the history of the sport. On the Warriors for his entire career.

Saturday, that legacy gets its next chapter signed, sealed, and delivered.

Are you a Curry fan? How many more seasons does he have left at an elite level?

x_posts.label: Post 4
x_posts.text:
Opening Night, October 20. Three games. All on NBC.

🏆 Knicks raise their first championship banner since 1973
👑 LeBron James and Jaylen Brown debut as 76ers — at MSG
🔥 OKC Thunder vs. San Antonio Spurs — WCF rematch

This is must-watch TV.

#HoopHeroes #NBA #OpeningNight

facebook.long_form:
🏆 October 20 can't come soon enough.

The NBA just unveiled Opening Night for the 2026-27 season, and it is LOADED. Three games. All on NBC. And every single one of them has something massive on the line.

**Game 1 (3 PM ET): Boston Celtics at Detroit Pistons**
The No. 2 seed (Celtics) visits the No. 1 seed (Pistons) from last year's East standings. Last year's best teams renewing rivalries on Day 1.

**Game 2 (7 PM ET): Philadelphia 76ers at New York Knicks — THE MAIN EVENT**
The defending NBA champion New York Knicks will raise their first championship banner since 1973. Their first title in over FIVE DECADES. And they host LeBron James, Embiid, and the retooled 76ers for LeBron's debut in Philadelphia's jersey. At Madison Square Garden. In front of a banner ceremony the Garden has been waiting 53 years for. Cinema.

**Game 3 (9:30 PM ET): Oklahoma City Thunder at San Antonio Spurs**
The rematch of last year's Western Conference Finals. The Spurs won 4-3 in seven games. They play 12 times across all competition formats last season — and the Thunder want revenge.

Which game are you watching first? 👇

stories.title: Kawhi Leonard — Trade to Toronto Still on Hold Before Training Camp

x_posts.label: Post 5
x_posts.text:
The Kawhi Leonard situation: still on hold.

NBA investigation resolution expected ~September 22. Kawhi is operating under belief the trade to Toronto clears before camp starts Sept. 28.

26 days. The clock is ticking. ⏳

#Clippers #Raptors #HoopHeroes

facebook.long_form:
The waiting game continues for Kawhi Leonard and the Toronto Raptors.

The trade — Leonard to Toronto for Brandon Ingram, Gradey Dick, and a package of draft picks — was agreed upon on June 30. It's now August 27. And it's still not official.

The NBA investigation into whether the Los Angeles Clippers circumvented the salary cap (through sponsorship deals with Kawhi involving Aspiration and Daktronics) has been ongoing for weeks. Leonard himself was cleared personally — no evidence he received improper payments through Clippers owner Steve Ballmer.

But the Clippers? Sanctions are expected.

Here's the encouraging part: league sources believe the investigation is "closer to completion than advertised." The resolution is expected within six weeks of August 10 — which puts us around September 22. Toronto's training camp starts September 28 in Quebec City.

Kawhi is working under the belief the trade will be officially approved before camp. He'd parachute in with just days to spare.

26 days. The clock is ticking.

Do you think the trade gets done? Or does something go sideways?
